items.title: NoLife Models — Exploring Local AI Runtime Infrastructure
items.summary: A Darkwood technical presentation about model catalogs, local inference runtimes, evaluation, governance and portable traces. NoLife Models illustrates a thin experimental slice through this stack; the PDF links to the canonical presentation for interactive demonstrations.Canonical interactive presentation: https://slides.darkwood.com/slides/nolife-local-runtime-infrastructure

items.title: When AI Becomes a Library — The Nolife Local Experiment
items.summary: A Darkwood experiment with Depth Anything 3, a local native runtime, Symfony, PHP FFI and Darkwood Flow. The presentation follows inference ownership, observability, a double-inference bug and the limits of the measured performance results.Canonical interactive presentation: https://slides.darkwood.com/slides/nolife-local

items.title: Nolife Language — Don’t say cost. Say investment.
items.summary: A Darkwood experiment on language, framing and token cost. The slides compare wording, encodings and measured regressions, distinguishing a small dated corpus from general claims about languages or pricing.Canonical interactive presentation: https://slides.darkwood.com/slides/nolife-language

items.title: Laravel Pipeline & Darkwood Flow
items.summary: Two execution models for composing PHP steps. A Darkwood comparison of closure composition, explicit next middleware, dataflow packets, drivers and concurrent waits, with clear limits on what the demonstration proves.Canonical interactive presentation: https://slides.darkwood.com/slides/laravel-pipeline-flow

items.title: Holding the Core — Security Engineering Through Darkwaar40: Breach
items.summary: A Darkwood technical presentation connecting the Breach game mechanics with attack surfaces, detection, patching, identity and continuous security operations. The game is a learning metaphor; technical limits and implementation status are stated in the slides.Canonical interactive presentation: https://slides.darkwood.com/slides/holding-the-core-security-engineering-through-darkwaar40-breach

items.title: From No-Life Testing to Behavioral Testing
items.summary: AI made writing tests cheap. Choosing what deserves an oracle is now the hard part. A Darkwood technical presentation on behavioral tests, meaningful oracles, runtime independence and Darkwood Flow jobs.Canonical interactive presentation: https://slides.darkwood.com/slides/from-nolife-testing-to-behavioral-testing
